scope.purpose: Read-only integration map from the accepted CODE-PROOF kernel source snapshot to the future public code-evidence workflow.
excluded: Git mutations, provider actions, network and subprocess execution
real repository acquisition, Vault writes and human-gate closure

existing_code_surfaces.use: Reuse the accepted pure Git framing, identity and full object proof after public request/bundle binding.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: Pass exact retained bytes and materialized five-key git limits; preserve kernel error codes/details and do not reinterpret a valid incomplete target result as an interrupted acquisition.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Reuse the accepted pure JSON/TOML typed configuration parser for one selected proved source blob.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: Feed only retained strict source bytes, exact json/toml mode and request.config limits; keep source-only explicit and install no config artifact on parser refusal.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Reuse pure UTF-8/control/BOM/newline normalization and text metadata where the public contract permits it.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: Do not use the legacy manifest/origin contract to narrow CODE successor IDs or to create public handoffs; public text metadata must bind the new request/observation records and profile limits.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Reuse canonical paper-ID acceptance only after exact-string/type checks.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: Do not use is_repo_id as the R9 repository validator; public CODE uses the frozen bounded owner/name grammar and lowercases only the ordinary request repository spelling.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Use canonicalize for ce1 identity material and exact saved envelope bytes.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: Apply strict JSON preflight/type checks before canonicalization; append one LF to each saved envelope and hash complete bytes for references.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Preserve the existing outer CLI success/error envelope.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: The new command-result schema validates successful data only; do not replace {ok,command,data} or {ok:false,command,error:{code,message,details}}.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Reference existing checkout/batch vocabulary and low-level descriptor helpers while implementing a distinct CODE retained session.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: R6 requires one retained graph for the whole public command. Do not compose independent _open_batch_session calls, use path-only aliases, or reuse legacy _atomic_install for CODE publication. Existing validate_batch_id uses isinstance and needs an exact-type check in the public boundary.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Reference the existing compact transaction-bundle encoding and retained staging semantics only where a future CODE adapter explicitly proves compatibility.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: This is an existing transaction-inspect transport, not the CODE public saved bundle or installer; do not silently route CODE handoffs through it.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Keep the existing pinned claude-obsidian adapter as a separate legacy capture path.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: CODE handoff is successor-only and zero-egress; it must not invoke this subprocess/provider authority path or the legacy manual capture flow.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Reuse retained immutable resource-view mechanics only after selecting and pinning the exact CODE resource set.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: The default loader enumerates all package/source schemas and has CWD fallback in adjacent helpers; public CODE must use an explicit ten-name filtered view and retained bytes with no unrelated discovery or fallback.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Reference Draft 2020-12 Registry integration and error translation only.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: Do not reuse the cached legacy all-schema registry unchanged. Build a fresh registry from the retained exact ten schemas and deny undeclared retrieval; preserve strict semantic replay outside JSON Schema.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Inventory legacy canonical publication compatibility only.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: Leave unchanged. It consumes legacy inspected manifest, repo-record and alignment documents, requires legacy 40-hex commit semantics and officiality, and is not a CODE-PROOF handoff consumer.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Keep existing staged code-map capture behavior intact.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: Do not add public CODE proof behavior here; existing code-map uses approval/plan/transaction/Vault authority and remains a distinct command family.

existing_code_surfaces.use: Add one top-level code-evidence parser group and five leaf handler bindings.
existing_code_surfaces.integration_rule: Insert code-evidence alongside code-map; preserve all existing parser branches and the global envelope/error behavior. New handlers should expose only the R2 flags and should not require vault/upstream roots.

legacy_resource_and_packaging_facts.package_rule: src/video_paper_wiki is already a Hatch wheel package; root schemas/ is force-included as video_paper_wiki/schemas/. A profile under src/video_paper_wiki/profiles/ needs no pyproject edit, but installed-wheel parity must be checked.
legacy_resource_and_packaging_facts.permitted_test_change: Change only the existing schema-count assertion from 71 to 81, and only after all ten exact new root schema files are present. Preserve all 71 prior schema bytes and all other assertions.

leaves.reads: one acquisition input and, only in git_objects mode, one retained external bundle directory
writes: sorted raw object bodies when raw mode

leaves.reads: complete retained raw observation and selected proved source blob
returns: config evidence or explicit source-only result

leaves.reads: complete retained raw observation and all required dependencies
returns: deterministic per-target handoffs and local source body paths

batch_rules: One batch has one request, one intent and at most one completed observation.
Identical repeat input is idempotent; changed request/acquisition requires a new batch.
Normalized-only evidence cannot be upgraded to raw proof within the same batch.
Status is read-only and does not repair, create, delete or adopt entries.
No public command makes network calls, starts subprocesses, reads Git configuration, imports supplied code or writes a Vault.

outer_envelope.result_schema_scope: successful data payloads for the five leaves only

new_product_modules.responsibility: Read and retain the exact profile plus ten CODE schemas from the imported package/source origins, verify size/hash/shape/reference closure, and construct a fresh filtered registry.
must_not: trust profile self-declared hashes as the sole root
cache a registry across resource generations

new_product_modules.responsibility: Own one retained descriptor/lineage graph and the fixed .work/<batch>/code-evidence-v1 namespace for each command, including all-exits verification and no-replace installation.
must_not: follow symlinks or normalize caller path spelling
install before pure preflight and peak simulation

new_product_modules.responsibility: Pure public orchestration for request/observe/status/config/handoff: strict input admission, document identity, retained-state classification, kernel replay, derived equality and bounded public error contexts.
must_not: reinterpret normalized text as Git proof
drop fields to satisfy a saved-byte cap

existing_files_to_modify.change: Add the code-evidence group and five handler bindings at the existing parser layer; leave code-map and legacy handlers unchanged.
Only 71 -> 81 count expectation after resource generation; no other legacy test edits.

files_not_to_modify_for_this_integration: existing code kernel modules except explicitly reviewed adapter glue
new_tests_suggested: tests/unit/test_code_proof_resources.py (only if resource loader needs isolated unit coverage)

session_shape: open_code_session(batch_id) retains checkout authority, installed CODE resources and initial output state before yielding.
retain_input retains one exact-spelled ordinary input and its named lineage.
retain_bundle_manifest retains one disjoint canonical raw bundle root/object set before reading its manifest.
retain_bundle_bodies reads only that retained root and validated inventory.
set_output_limits materializes one positive narrowing within hard maxima.
install publishes only owned payloads with initial-identical reuse; later arrivals are lineage failures.
verify and finalizer run on every success, refusal, parse, cap, install and cleanup path.
filesystem_policy: Retain each lexical ancestor and first named edge/absence; do not resolve, realpath, normpath or repair spelling.
Acquire nonblocking checkout lock before resource/work scans and keep duplicate lock descriptor through cleanup.
Use descriptor-relative no-follow open/stat/mkdir/link/unlink and directory fsync; refuse unsupported primitives.
New .work, batch, namespace and family directories are 0700; generated files are 0600.
Install with no-replace hard-link publication and owned temporary cleanup; never replacing rename/copy.
Final persistent lineage failure overrides earlier semantic, parser, limit or I/O errors.
preflight_policy: Cap raw request input at 65536 bytes and raw observe input at 1048576 bytes before JSON decoding.
Validate complete request/intent/observation/config/handoff derivations and canonical saved bytes before first new write.
Simulate deterministic install sequence from retained current byte count; require C+2*N <= max_output_peak_bytes for each absent payload.
Recheck saved caps for complete bytes; never truncate or omit evidence fields.

state_families.raw_object_prefix: Only an OID-sorted exact prefix is valid while raw acquisition is incomplete.
state_families.handoff_prefix: Only a path-ordered prefix of requested targets is valid; late or non-prefix entries refuse.
state_families.normalized_mode: Forbids raw objects/configs/handoffs and can never become raw proof.

request_identity: Closed request data: paper_id, source_association, repository, object_format, commit_oid, targets, require_repository_assertion, limits, profile_sha256.
Repository uses R9 owner/name grammar and one lowercasing step; saved request/bundle/hosting spelling is then exact.
paper_id uses exact-string validation plus is_canonical_paper_id; association remains retained but source_association_verified is always false in phase 1.
raw_proof: Raw bundle repeats request identity and stores exact commit/root tree/object declarations; body set is retained before verification.
verify_code_git_objects is replayed from stored body bytes for completed raw observations.
Complete_target_set means every requested target is source_text; missing/unsafe/unsupported observations remain valid evidence but cannot handoff.
normalized_observation: Every requested target appears exactly once in request order with present or closed other outcome.
Normalized text is already LF-oriented strict source text; no Git/raw-byte/config-span authority is inferred.
configuration: Requires complete raw observation, selected requested path and configuration role.
Source-only retains proved source bytes/ref/reason without invoking typed parser.
JSON/TOML results must equal pure parser output from retained blob bytes and request config limits.
handoff: Successor-only handoff binds full-width SHA-1/SHA-256 commit/tree/blob IDs, object format, request, observation, body and proof.
Handoff requires complete source_text target set and any requested repository assertion; it does not call legacy capture or canonical compiler.
legacy_compatibility: Do not narrow full-width successor IDs into code-evidence-manifest.v1 or canonical_compiler._code.
Do not claim officiality, repository ownership or source association verification from Git proof, host assertion or locator construction.
Do not alter existing code-map CLI behavior, outer envelope, 71 legacy schemas, kernel limits, kernel errors or transaction/upstream adapters.

resource_gate: Generate and independently verify exact ten Draft 2020-12 schemas plus profile bytes, hashes, titles, IDs, refs and no undeclared retrieval.
Verify package/source origins and isolated-wheel byte parity; source snapshot currently has none of these resources.
public_contract_gate: Cover all five leaves, raw SHA-1/SHA-256 and normalized modes, incomplete states, target ineligibility, source-only/JSON/TOML config and handoff prefix repair.
Exercise input caps, saved caps, peak caps, canonical bytes, IDs/refs, wrong kinds, duplicate/unknown fields and semantic derivation forgery.
Exercise retained-lineage failures on checkout, resource, input, bundle, output directories/files, temp/link/cleanup and all-exits ordering.
regression_gate: Run affected contract tests and both locked Python suites only after exact source/resource snapshot freeze.
Build isolated wheel and compare all old schema bytes plus ten new schemas/profile byte-for-byte.
Record exact implementation head/tree, CI checkout SHA and test run separately from this read-only map.
not_established_by_this_map: real host/repository acquisition or canonical publication
